## Case studies
- [Icestasy: replacing a WhatsApp-run business](https://dcostat04.github.io/trevorportfolio/work/icestasy.html): Product Management Intern, Jun–Nov 2026. Pitched and built an AI order desk (70–100 orders/day; order entry from 10–15 min to under 2), production planning linked to sales, and an HRMS.
- [SHC Growth Partners: how many deals can one advisor run?](https://dcostat04.github.io/trevorportfolio/work/shc.html): designed a compliance rules engine, investor matching and a seven-stage pipeline, designed so one advisor could handle 50 deals instead of 5. Pitched, not deployed.
- [Barclays: storage alerts people trust again](https://dcostat04.github.io/trevorportfolio/work/barclays.html): incident response time down 48%, downtime down 30%, 60%+ of remediation automated. Promoted to BA4 within 20 months.
